verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own docs say it turns a text prompt into a finished video through its AI Assistant, which covers the core prompt-to-video part of the story. The iteration part is thinly evidenced: refining a prompt-generated result in place is not documented. Only general editing workflows and the 'fully editable' claim for PPT-derived videos come close. missing for 10: documented iterative refinement or regeneration of prompt-generated videos without starting over, independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt-to-video quality.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Turn any prompt, link, or file into a polished video with helpful AI Assistant.
Write a prompt and add context. Get a finished video.
Work with teammates on video projects using shared workspaces, commenting, review, and editing workflows.
